title: Glitch lab 2 (source of the round-2 templates)
summary: The 8 comps the round-2 Glitch templates were built and verified in: glitch lower third, block artifact title, error cascade, terminal type-on, stutter words, RGB split mark, tracking band and pixel dissolve.
use_when: You want to see a round-2 glitch template working before using it, copy a comp's objects, or re-extract a template with comp_to_template.py.
parameters: random seeds for blocks, jumps and pixel order (regenerate)
carvercat_version: built and verified in Carvercat 0.1.6 (rev 1105,; public release binary, headless; pack added to the bundled Library for the test), 2026-10-27
copy_notes: Comps have a 'Lab bg' rectangle (dropped on extraction) except GL Tracking band and GL Pixel dissolve.
Clip ids are unique per comp (glt_, gbt_, gec_, gtm_, gsw_, grm_, gtb_, gpd_).
Rebuild: ai/scripts/motion/glitch_lab2.py writes the comps (cc.textw needs Pillow); apply its PRESETS with preset.apply, then edit.save.
Every comp lints 0 errors / 0 warnings; qc at 240 px finds no flashes.
source: Carvercat team, built with an AI agent, 2026-10-27
